# Red Stag Painting

> Premium residential painting contractor serving Greater Los Angeles since 2011. Interior, exterior, cabinet, stucco, and specialty painting with a 2-year warranty. Owner-led walkthroughs, in-house crews, Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore paints only.

## Contact

- Phone: (626) 652-2303
- Email: support@redstagcc.com
- Website: https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 7am–6pm PT
- Owner: Israel Aquino
- Founded: 2011

## Services

- [Interior Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/interior-painting): Full-room and whole-house interior repaints. Typical range $400–$900/room, $2,500–$6,500+ whole house. 2–4 days for a 3-bedroom interior.
- [Exterior Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/exterior-painting): Stucco, siding, and trim. Typical range $4,000–$18,000+ depending on square footage. 3–7 days.
- [Cabinet Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/cabinet-painting): Factory-finish sprayed cabinets. Typical range $2,500–$10,000.
- [Drywall Repair & Paint](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/drywall-repair-paint): Patch, skim, prime, and repaint.
- [Popcorn Ceiling Removal](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/popcorn-ceiling-removal): Scrape, skim-coat, and paint. Typical range $600–$4,500.
- [Stucco Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/stucco-painting): Elastomeric coatings and repair. Typical range $4,000–$15,000+.
- [Trim & Baseboard Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/trim-baseboard-painting): Trim, crown, baseboard, doors.
- [Color Change Repaint](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/color-change-repaint): Dark-to-light or full color overhauls.
- [Rental Turnover Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/rental-turnover-painting): Fast move-in-ready repaints.
- [Wallpaper Removal](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/wallpaper-removal): Strip, prep walls, prime, repaint.
- [Ceiling Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/ceiling-painting): Flat, knockdown, vaulted. Typical range $200–$2,500.
- [Garage Painting](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/garage-painting): Floors, walls, ceilings. Typical range $800–$4,500.
- [Wood & Deck Staining](https://red-stag-painting.vercel.app/wood-deck-staining): Fences, decks, pergolas. Typical range $800–$6,500.
